reason: Hypothesis B proposes a specific, non-trivial post-treatment (HCPEB) that physically remelts and randomizes the columnar Cr coating, directly addressing the fast oxygen diffusion limitation, and it combines evidence from Cr coating oxidation (E3) with HCPEB-induced grain refinement on Zircaloy (E1) to predict a measurable 20% oxide reduction, whereas Hypothesis A merely restates the known benefit of random grain orientation without a concrete, novel method to achieve it beyond vague parameter optimization.
